A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
laparoscopic surgery is the preferred approach in most patients with benign diseases, but that the decision to perform open versus laparoscopic surgery for malignancies needs further research.
laparoscopic surgery is the gold standard for the following conditions: GERD, obesity surgery, colorectal surgery (malignant and benign), and hysterectomy.
QoL after laparoscopic and open surgery are comparable in the majority of conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
QoL is an important factor in surgical decision making and that it can be measured reliably.
laparoscopic surgery is not a panacea.
